messages.text:
BL-1059 — 516 of 792 closed tickets say status: todo — the field mirrors the folder by hand, was swept clean once in July, and drifted all the way back within six weeks
What it solves: SEVERITY RATIONALE: `medium`, not `high`. No work is lost and no machine
decision is currently wrong — every consumer reads the folder first, and the
one that reads the value reads it behind the folder check. It is not a
broken safety signal, so it does not meet the `high` band. It is real and
cont…
Approval context: One decision, with a recommendation, and one thing that is firm.
The decision is whether the `status:` field should MIRROR the folder or STOP mirroring it. Recommendation: stop. Every mover in the repo already declines to write the field deliberately and says so in a comment — backlogWriter.ts mark…
BL-1059 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1059" (or "reject BL-1059 <reason>") to act.
